WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 31, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70707 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta closed on October 23 at level 30, so nothing above 30 was tested by players; talents and spells past 30 come from the launch client and Blizzard's posts. One warning is specific to this spec: a widely-published level-30 Elemental build is not legal on the launch client. It spends 5 points on Elemental FuryElemental FuryTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%., which sits at row 6, so it needs 26 points, not 21. That site's data predates the change, and its prose and its own screenshot disagree besides. Nothing circulating counts as a published level-30 Elemental build. Spell tooltips read the base game client and can lag a hotfix, so where one differs from the text here, trust the text.

If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.. Blizzard cut it because it "was twice as strong as similar talents with other classes, causing a spell power scaling problem." Lava BurstLava BurstLevel 30 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 4Cast2.5 sec castCost135 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownYou hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 114 to 145 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage. sits at 21 points, so you can have it at 30. The base-spell-damage half of the quotation stands.

The base-damage half matters more than it reads. Forever cut base spell damage across the board and moved the power onto gear. One guide spells out the consequence: "all caster specs, and for Shaman that's Elemental, will need to constantly upgrade their gear to deal decent damage." An Elemental Shaman in stale gear is genuinely weak in a way a Classic one was not (ours, not a source's).

Ratings: Overall 3.0, Levelling 3.0.

Rotation

  1. Pre-place your totems before the pull. Searing TotemSearing TotemLevel 10 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaDuration30 secSummons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 30 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 9 to 11 Fire damage. goes last, because it starts attacking
  2. Lightning BoltLightning BoltLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 10Cast1.5 sec castCost15 ManaRange30 yd rangeCasts a bolt of lightning at the target for 14 to 17 Nature damage. to pull

Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets. takes over from level 32 (ours, not a source's).

Stat priority

Spell Power, then Hit, Haste, critical strike, Intellect, MP5, Spirit, Stamina.

Nature damage and plain spell power lead equally. Then comes "Intellect, which is how many bolts you get before you have to sit down." Take leather over cloth where the stats are otherwise equal.

Forever moved caster power from base spells onto gear, so the published advice is to "constantly upgrade". Replace pieces aggressively.
